Full summary: 2.8.0 shipped to npm latest (Publish green, ~70s) with plugin 1.26.0 — D7 fix live: per-decision affected_files/affected_symbols on structured decisions. Field's carrier rule retirable once their machines upgrade.
Findings: Ship state: v2.8.0 tag -> Publish workflow green -> npm latest = 2.8.0 confirmed via npm view; commits 440b48f (fix + wave-2 disposition docs) / 4b3b84a (plugin 1.26.0 bundle) / bdce0dc (version). Main-branch CI carries the known pre-existing token-budget red (since 2.6.0), unrelated to Publish; need: local plugin installs on this machine and the field machines still pin older plugin versions — upgrading closes D7 exposure; remember BOTH user and project scopes when updating the local pin (proven shadowing hazard)
